svg.title: Two same-sized, tilted phones showing a feedback flow, centered
svg.desc: Hero illustration of two identically sized, angled smartphones centered in the frame. The back phone shows a partially completed feedback form with a star rating, checkboxes, and text answers, one question still empty. The front phone, positioned to the left and higher up, shows a completed state with a checkmark and thank-you message.
